brief.product: An owner portal for a small animal veterinary practice. Owners sign in after a visit to read the vet's notes, see vaccination dates and pay an invoice.

accent.why: A calm teal suits a veterinary practice serving anxious pet owners, sits well clear of red and amber, and avoids the sky blue most clinic portals use.

temperature.why: Pet owners reading notes about their own animals are people-facing health work, which the standard gives warm greys.

pairing.why: Owners come to read a vet's notes and trust what they say, so a quiet serif at title size fits better than a mono face for a portal with no reference codes in every row.

radius.why: The users are the public checking on a pet, not staff working with dense data, so round corners fit a consumer-facing portal.

density.why: Owners open the portal occasionally after a visit and are not trained staff working all day, so comfortable spacing is the only allowed choice.

motif.why: The brief chooses the top nav shell for a people-facing app, where one warm block of colour on the first tile reads as welcome rather than alarm.

copy.headline: Everything from your pet's last visit
copy.tagline: Read the vet's notes, check upcoming vaccinations and settle your invoice in one place.
copy.why: It names the three things an owner actually came to do after a visit, in the practice's own voice rather than software terms.
